systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous High-Pressure Supercritical CO2 Micro-Bubble Carbonation & Sterilizer Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Industrial Dense-Phase Cold Beverage Pasteurizer & Carbonator (ASME Section VIII Div 1 / 3-A Sanitary Standards 04-05 & 44-03 / EHEDG Class I Aseptic)
systemArchitectures.technology: High-Pressure Multi-Piston Booster Pump (75–160 bar) with Sintered Porous Titanium Micro-Spargers & Pressurized Plug-Flow Loop
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Electropolished AISI 316L (UNS S31603) & Solid Hastelloy C-276 (Ra ≤ 0.38 µm / 15 µ-in)
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Dual ASME UV-Stamped Rupture Disks (175 bar), Automated Back-Pressure Relief Loop, and Rapid CO2 Scrubber Depressurization Relays
systemArchitectures.description: High-throughput industrial skid engineered for cold-fill canning and bottling of craft ciders, non-alcoholic beers, and functional beverages. Infuses dense-phase supercritical carbon dioxide (scCO2, 80–140 bar, 25–35°C) via sub-micron porous titanium dispersers, creating micro-bubbles (<3 µm) that achieve instantaneous Henry's law dissolution and >6.5-log pathogen/yeast inactivation without any thermal heat exposure.

systemArchitectures.name: Industrial Continuous Counter-Current Dense-Phase scCO2 Stripping & Sterilizer Column
systemArchitectures.classification: Continuous Counter-Current Beverage Pasteurization & De-Aeration Column (FDA Juice HACCP 21 CFR § 120 / CE-PED 2014/68/EU)
systemArchitectures.technology: Pressurized Multi-Stage Structured Packing Column with Counter-Current Supercritical Fluid Inflow & Bottom Sanitary Scavenger
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: AISI 316L Stainless Steel with Electropolished Structured Packing (Sulzer Mellapak 316L)
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Liquid-Level Ultrasonic Overfill Interlocks, High-Pressure Safety Valves, and In-Line Gas Chromatography Purity Analyzers
systemArchitectures.description: Engineered for high-volume juice and cold-pressed botanical processors requiring simultaneous oxygen stripping, volatile sulfide stripping, and vegetative spore pasteurization. Liquid beverage trickles downward over high-efficiency structured packing while supercritical CO2 flows upward, stripping dissolved oxygen to <5 ppb and rupturing spoilage microbial cell membranes via cytoplasmic acidification.

systemArchitectures.name: Sanitary High-Shear Micro-Venturi scCO2 Infuser & Homogenizer Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Compact In-Line High-Shear Carbonation & Bio-Stabilization Skid (3-A Sanitary Standard 74-07 / EHEDG Clean-In-Place Validated)
systemArchitectures.technology: Dual Micro-Venturi Hydrodynamic Vortex Cavitation Chamber with High-Precision Electronically Modulated Back-Pressure Valve
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Titanium Grade 5 Micro-Nozzles with Electropolished AISI 316L Venturi Housing (Ra ≤ 0.25 µm)
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Differential Pressure Auto-Bypass, Vibration Peak Sensors, and Emergency Hydraulic Dump Valve
systemArchitectures.description: Compact modular system designed for craft cideries, kombucha breweries, and botanical beverage co-packers. Uses multi-point micro-venturi nozzles to shatter dense-phase CO2 streams into a uniform dispersion of micro-bubbles under controlled turbulence, providing rapid in-line saturation and microbial stabilization in a footprint under 3.5 m².

systemArchitectures.name: Modular Cleanroom Pilot Supercritical CO2 Beverage Inactivation & Carbonation Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Aseptic Beverage R&D and Process Validation Testbed (ISO 7 Class 10,000 Cleanroom / 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records Compliant)
systemArchitectures.technology: Multi-Zone High-Pressure Sapphire Optical View-Cell Reactor with Integrated Dynamic Light Scattering & In-Line Densimeter
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Hastelloy C-22 Autoclave Chamber with Single-Crystal Sapphire Optical Ports (Ra ≤ 0.15 µm)
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Burst Rupture Disc (200 bar), Triple Redundant Pressure Transducers, and Optical Window Thermal Expansion Guards
systemArchitectures.description: Precision pilot research skid designed for food scientists and beverage microbiologists measuring Henry's law solubility isotherms, phase equilibrium transitions, microbial D-values, and non-thermal enzyme inactivation kinetics across experimental botanical matrices.

beverageMatrices.name: Craft Hard Apple Cider & Pear Perry
beverageMatrices.spoilageTargetOrganisms: Zygosaccharomyces bailii, Brettanomyces bruxellensis, Lactobacillus plantarum
beverageMatrices.criticalAromaCompounds: Isoamyl acetate, ethyl hexanoate, malic acid balance, crisp ester aroma
beverageMatrices.description: Susceptible to refermentation in cans/bottles by osmotolerant Zygosaccharomyces bailii. Supercritical CO2 micro-bubbles eliminate live yeasts while preserving heat-sensitive delicate fruit esters and floral esters ruined by tunnel pasteurization.

beverageMatrices.name: Non-Alcoholic Craft Malt Beverage (<0.5% ABV)
beverageMatrices.spoilageTargetOrganisms: Lactobacillus brevis, Pediococcus damnosus, Bacillus cereus
beverageMatrices.criticalAromaCompounds: Myrcene, humulene, linalool, hop dry-hop polyphenols, malt sweet wort balance
beverageMatrices.description: Lacking protective ethanol and acidity, NA beers are extremely vulnerable to lactic acid bacterial souring and diacetyl spoilage. scCO2-MBC achieves 6-log destruction of beer spoilers without boiling off volatile hop oils or forming pasteurization off-flavors.

beverageMatrices.name: Cold-Pressed Cloudy Valencia Orange & Tangerine Juice
beverageMatrices.spoilageTargetOrganisms: Alicyclobacillus acidoterrestris, Leuconostoc mesenteroides, Pichia anomala
beverageMatrices.criticalAromaCompounds: L-Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), Valencene, Citral, Native Pectin Suspension
beverageMatrices.description: High thermal sensitivity causes loss of fresh citrus aroma and browning. scCO2-MBC delivers FDA 5-log Juice HACCP pathogen reduction, strips dissolved oxygen to halt ascorbic acid degradation, and retains fresh natural cloudy turbidity.

beverageMatrices.name: Sparkling Botanical Adaptogen & Hop Water Tonic
beverageMatrices.spoilageTargetOrganisms: Saccharomyces cerevisiae, Mold spores (Aspergillus, Penicillium), Acetobacter
beverageMatrices.criticalAromaCompounds: Ashwagandha withanolides, terpene fractions, delicate elderflower bioactives
beverageMatrices.description: Zero-sugar adaptogenic tonics require high sparkling effervescence (3.5–4.0 vols) without chemical benzoate or sorbate preservatives. scCO2-MBC provides high-effervescence carbonation and pristine aseptic shelf stability.

beverageMatrices.name: Raw Sparkling Kombucha & Fermented Herbal Tea
beverageMatrices.spoilageTargetOrganisms: Excessive over-attenuating wild yeasts, Brettanomyces, film-forming Mycoderma
beverageMatrices.criticalAromaCompounds: Glucuronic acid, epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG), organic acetic notes
beverageMatrices.description: Stabilizes live kombucha by selectively eliminating wild yeast refermentation that causes can bulging and excessive alcohol accumulation above 0.5% ABV during room-temperature logistics.

microbubbleGenerators.name: Sintered Nano-Porous Titanium Grade 2 Micro-Sparger Cartridge
microbubbleGenerators.description: Engineered with uniform sub-micron interconnected pores. Disperses supercritical CO2 into billions of micro-bubbles per milliliter, providing an immense contact surface area that enables instantaneous Henry's law saturation and cell envelope lysis in under 3 seconds.

microbubbleGenerators.name: Multi-Stage Micro-Venturi Vortex Cavitation Injector
microbubbleGenerators.description: Employs high-velocity fluid contraction and localized hydrodynamic shearing to chop supercritical CO2 streams into fine micro-droplets. Highly resistant to particulate clogging, making it optimal for pulpy juices and unfiltered ciders.

microbubbleGenerators.name: Hydrophobic Ceramic α-Al2O3 / Zirconia Micro-Porcelain Disperser
microbubbleGenerators.description: Monolithic ceramic tube with controlled sub-micron surface porosity. Produces monodisperse ultra-fine micro-bubbles with zero droplet coalescence, enabling maximum microbial membrane mechanical disruption at minimal working pressure.

microbubbleGenerators.name: Conventional Coarse Drilled Stainless Pipe Sparger (Hazardous Control)
microbubbleGenerators.cavitationErosionResistance: Poor (Prone to Severe Gas Pocket Hammer)
microbubbleGenerators.description: Macro-bubble injection creates erratic gas pockets and insufficient contact area. CO2 fails to dissolve rapidly, microbial lethality drops to near zero (<0.4 log), and severe downstream gas-hammer damages sanitary valves and packaging cans.

carbonationPressureRegimes.name: Supercritical scCO2 High-Pressure Regime (P ≥ 73.8 bar, T ≥ 31.1°C)
carbonationPressureRegimes.description: Optimal dense-phase fluid state. CO2 exhibits liquid-like density for high solvating power and gas-like diffusivity for instant cellular membrane penetration, cytoplasmic acidification, and enzyme uncoupling.

carbonationPressureRegimes.name: Subcritical Liquid High-Pressure Regime (P = 50 - 72 bar, T = 12 - 25°C)
carbonationPressureRegimes.description: High equilibrium CO2 solubility but lower microbial membrane fluidity disruption due to liquid viscosity. Requires extended residence contact time (60–120 s) to achieve commercial spore sterility.

carbonationPressureRegimes.name: Conventional Low-Pressure Chilled Gas Regime (P = 2 - 5 bar, T = 1 - 4°C)
carbonationPressureRegimes.solubilityKinetics: Slow (Requires Hours in Carbonation Brite Tanks)
carbonationPressureRegimes.description: Standard carbonation tank method. Zero microbial pasteurization effect. Requires chemical preservatives (potassium sorbate/sodium benzoate) or high-temperature heat tunnel pasteurization.
